title: Satellites Found Half The Ocean Changing Color
hook: The shift covers more ocean than all Earth's land.
closing: Ocean color tracks living systems, so a planetary shift demands attention.
question: What could this shift mean?

segments.say: Ocean color changed across 56 percent of the surface. The shift is already planetary, not local.
Models predicted 50 percent would change. Satellites later found the forecast was too small.
Changed ocean spans 203 million square kilometers. That exceeds all Earth's land, making this impossible to dismiss as a patch.
